predictor.notes: Retained after testing alternative affine and quadratic band models: those also fit every successful response, so no evidence supports replacing this simpler predictor. It matches all eight estimates at their reported 10,000-cent precision and both exact prices: 159900 cents at quantity 50 and 373000 cents at quantity 200, each export-confirmed. No new business requests were made: the increased study budget does not reset the exhausted shared estimate allowance, and the available exact approvals were already observed. Conditional on the retained rates, any second-band start from 151 through 200 fits; 176 remains provisional. Quantities above 400 are unobserved extrapolation. Different coefficients, curvature, or additional bands remain possible, so exact reconstruction across 1–1000 is not established.
